answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 24125 Country: India Title: Please tell me what is the last time till we can do fajar salah? how much time before sunrise we can do fajar salah. Question: asalamalaikum dear sir please tell me what is the last time till we can do fajar salah? how much time before sunrise we can do fajar salah. thanks and regards siddiqui Answer ID: 24125 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1200/911/L=1431) The time for Fajr salah continues up to sunrise. You can offer Fajr before it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
